title: UtopiaHire: AI Career Architect for an Inclusive Future of Work

main: IEEE CN Tunisia Section Affinity Group

overview.scope: Design and develop UtopiaHire, an AI-powered platform that promotes fairness and inclusivity in employment for job seekers across Sub-Saharan Africa and the MENA region. Deliver a modular, scalable MVP that can evolve with additional features.
overview.goal: Build a functional prototype demonstrating how AI can enhance career development and employment equity, while ensuring privacy, fairness, transparency and security-by-design.

target_audience: Job seekers across Sub-Saharan Africa and MENA (end-user persona / beneficiaries)

core_module_options.name: Resume Reviewer/Rewriter
core_module_options.description: NLP to analyze and improve resumes.

core_module_options.name: AI Interviewer & Profiler
core_module_options.description: Simulate virtual interviews and provide insights on strengths and weaknesses.

core_module_options.name: Job Matcher
core_module_options.description: Suggest regionally relevant job opportunities based on candidate profiles.

core_module_options.name: Footprint Scanner
core_module_options.description: Explore and analyze public contributions on LinkedIn, GitHub, StackOverflow.

problem_statement: Many candidates in emerging regions face high rejection rates due to outdated resumes, poor formatting, or algorithmic filtering and lack access to personalized career guidance or interview preparation. The task is to build an intelligent, fair, and secure solution to empower these job seekers to optimize applications, improve visibility, and prepare effectively.

deliverables: PDF report describing design and methodology
Demo video showing functionality and usability (anonymous)
